title: OpenArt · Legacy Stories and custom models will not migrate

implication: The user may have no affected assets; do not claim data was backed up or migrate anything. Official public FAQ and banner, no account inspection or export test.

title: Kling · Kling 4.0 direct API availability and output limits
summary: Official API Updates entry dated 10/28/2026 says Kling 4.0 API is fully available. Supports text/image/Omni reference endpoints, up to 30-second output, ten keyframes and voice references in Omni. Direct access requires a Flagship Resource Pack or account-manager balance funding. API notice specifies 720p/1080p; 10-bit 4K is still coming soon. This narrows the API claim but does not prove every consumer/host surface lacks 4K.
implication: Billing depends on input/output duration. Do not equate API availability with free access or repeat vendor motion/identity improvements as independently established. Exact UTC publication and API execution unverified. Vendor announcement and documented limits; no account call, purchase, output inspection or independent quality benchmark.

title: AssemblyAI · TTS-1 availability and three different latency clocks
date: 27 Oct announcement label; 28 Oct provider listing/evaluation; discovered 29 Oct
summary: Newly covered hosted TTS API with six languages, instant voice cloning and a $15 per million input-character list price. The launch lacks SSML, a speed parameter, pronunciation dictionaries, emotion tags and fine-tuned Pro cloning.
implication: A useful narration candidate to evaluate, but current evidence is mostly short English voice-agent material. Do not rank byte arrival, audible onset and end-to-end dialogue latency together. AA's accessible page did not expose numeric arena rows; vendor-reported arena rank was not independently verified here. No synthesis run.

title: Inworld · documented opt-in delivery direction
date: Observed 29 Oct · indexed developer-preview article dated 28 Oct; exact rollout unverified
summary: The documented TTS-2 reasoning option runs a language model that writes a delivery instruction before synthesis. Unspoken scene context can steer that instruction; the response exposes it. This is explicit orchestration, not evidence that an audio model internally performs chain-of-thought reasoning.
implication: Potentially useful for character lines and narrated scenes. Supported on TTS-2 unary, HTTP streaming and async synthesis; batch is upcoming, not Flash steering. Context is limited to 600 characters. Inline tags take precedence; timeout falls back to synthesis without direction. The step can delay first audio, and repeated requests need not choose the same direction.

title: Openjutsu · optional first-frame Relight
date: 29 Oct source commits · 12:17 UI; 13:46 separate node; public push times unknown
summary: From picture now offers nine light looks or custom light text, off by default. It poses and relights the prepared first frame in one FLUX 3 Klein image-edit pass at 3 MP. The image model receives the character image; the source frame reaches it through the prompt upsampler's written pose and canvas shape. Video rendering remains a separate user-reviewed stage.
implication: The separately added H3RelightPass normals/depth node is not called by the inspected UI patch. No measured identity or temporal-consistency gain; seed/background changes remain. No generation, and Turbo 8 preference is unchanged.

title: FastVideo FastH3 Omni reference-to-video/audio release announcement
date: 20 Oct 2026 · checked 26 Oct
summary: Reference-conditioned video/audio distillation combines 32 fine-grid predictions into eight fused transformer calls. PDD supervises the internal predictions; DMD supervises complete generated outputs. This makes the distinction between solver updates and expensive network evaluations concrete.
implication: Editorial inference: promising for faster reference-guided shot iteration. Compare final-shot quality, reference adherence and total latency, not just step counts. Complete serving recipes differ, so this is not an isolated distillation ablation. Base uses lossless rather than exact precision policy. Qualitative matched examples do not establish quality parity; optional 36-layer VAE comparisons are excluded from timing. Do not transfer server results to one consumer GPU.
